models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses:
When found in Brake Electronics Control Module (J104)
Brake Electronics Function Test activated
stepByStepSolution:
When found in Brake Electronics Control Module (J104)
Perform Brake Electronics Function Test
technicalNotes:
Might be stored in Combination with B10B3/037043 in Airbag Control Module (J234), if so perform Function Test first.
If the Brake Electronics Function Test procedure will not complete and fault codes are stored in other Powertrain Databus control modules diagnose those issues before replacing ESP components.
Refer to the Volkswagen Tech Tip [45-09-05] ONLY if the "Electronic Stabilization Program (ESP) function test does not end after several attempts!  https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2020/MC-10180603-0001.pdf  NHTSA
